covered_report_window: Tuesday, October 20, 2026 after the U.S. market close through Wednesday, October 21, 2026 before the U.S. market open
market_context_summary: U.S. equities were higher intraday, but persistent inflation, elevated global yields, AI-sector volatility, and oil near recent wartime highs create cross-currents. High jet fuel is especially material for airlines.
